description:
About CWILL
 CWILL (pronounced 'quill') is a post-purchase and retention suite built for Shopify brands. Reduce support tickets, recover lost revenue from returns, and turn one-time buyers into loyal fans — with tools purpose-built for every touchpoint that follows the sale.
 
 About the Role
 
 CWILL's engineering teams are building the next generation of SaaS products for Shopify brands — including AI-powered customer service tools and SEO optimization products. As our products grow, so does our need for strong engineering talent who can learn fast and ship real things.
 
 Our R&D Management Trainee program is built for engineers who are new to the workforce but ready to dig in. You'll be embedded in a product engineering team, working on production systems from day one with mentorship from senior engineers. Over time, you'll grow into an engineer who can independently own modules and make technical decisions.
 
 You'll be placed on one of our active product teams:
 TrackingMore: https://www.trackingmore.com 
 Loyalty & Referrals: https://www.cwill.com/products/loyalty-referrals/ 
 Pop-up & Email Marketing: https://www.cwill.com/products/pop-up-email-marketing/ 
 AI Chat: https://apps.shopify.com/channelwill-chat 
 SEO & Speed: https://www.cwill.com/products/seo-speed/ 
 
 What You'll Do
 Customer Issue Support 
 Investigate and resolve technical issues raised through user and customer-support tickets, quickly identifying the root cause of front-end and back-end failures (data discrepancies, API errors, display issues, and similar).
 Triage and prioritize incoming issues by severity; respond promptly to urgent cases, drive them through to a fix, and close the loop with the reporting team.
 Document recurring issues — producing troubleshooting guides and FAQs — to reduce repeat tickets over time.
 Work with the customer support and product teams to reproduce reported problems, and provide data corrections or interim workarounds where needed.
 
 System Maintenance & Bug Fixes
 Assist with production bug investigation, root cause analysis, and resolution
 Use logging, monitoring, and database tools to trace issues methodically
 Contribute to ongoing improvements in system stability, performance, and code maintainability
 
 Engineering Collaboration & Growth
 Follow team engineering standards: code reviews, documentation, and testing
 Proactively communicate progress, risks, and blockers
 Participate in post-launch retrospectives; continuously improve your code quality and engineering judgment
 As you grow, take on increasing ownership of modules and technical decisions
 Requirements 
 
 Recent graduate from a US university (BS or MS), or within 1–2 years of graduation
 Able to relocate to Cary NC. 
 Bilingual in Mandarin Chinese and English 
 Proficiency in at least one backend language: JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, Go, or PHP
 Web fundamentals: HTTP, RESTful API design, frontend-backend interaction, and relational databases
 Basic SQL and database understanding (MySQL or PostgreSQL)
 Able to read documentation, debug systematically, and own your work through completion
 Reliable and communicative — you surface problems early and follow through on commitments
 
 Nice to Have 
 Experience with any of: React, Node.js, Next.js, NestJS, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis
 AI/LLM project experience: prompt engineering, RAG, knowledge bases, chatbots, or content generation
 Shopify app development, independent store tech, SEO tools, or SaaS product experience
 Internship at a tech or SaaS company; open source contributions or personal project portfolio
 Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD, or cloud services (AWS, Aliyun, etc.)
 Active GitHub profile with consistent commit history
 Competitive programming background (ACM, LanQiao Cup, etc.)
 Experience with AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, etc.)
 Mandarin Chinese communication ability
 
 
 Benefits 
 Starting Pay: 60 - 80k depends on experiences, open to negotiation
 401(k) 
 PTO 
 Paid Holidays 
 Insurance
